name: What are the pros and cons of Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: What are the pros and cons of Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: Luxury Vinyl Plank (LVP) offers several advantages for bathrooms, including excellent water resistance, durability, and a wide variety of styles that mimic wood or stone. It's often more affordable than tile or natural stone and provides a warmer feel underfoot. Installation can be quicker and less messy than tile. However, LVP can be susceptible to dents from heavy objects, may not increase home value as much as tile or stone, and some lower-quality options can fade over time with direct sunlight exposure. It generally has a shorter lifespan than ceramic or porcelain tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: LVP pros: water-resistant, durable, affordable, diverse styles. Cons: susceptible to dents, less home value increase than tile, potential fading, shorter lifespan.
